entities.summary: Anders Mark Lee is an American professional ice hockey player who is a winger and captain for the New York Islanders of the National Hockey League (NHL). Lee attended the University of Notre Dame, where he played hockey for the Fighting Irish ice hockey team. The Islanders drafted him in the sixth round, 151st overall, in the 2009 NHL entry draft.
